title: GROUP BY
explain: GROUP BY collapses rows into groups so you can summarize each one with `COUNT`, `SUM`, `AVG`, `MIN` or `MAX`. `HAVING` filters groups after they are formed, while WHERE filters rows before. Every selected column must be either grouped or aggregated.
exercise: Find the highest score in each course, then keep only the courses with at least two students.
tip: Use WHERE to filter rows and HAVING to filter groups. Mixing them up is the most common GROUP BY error.
